title: Microsoft Copilot: comment on a Page to ask Copilot questions or request edits
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, existing Pages controls and licensing statements are supported. It distinguishes the planned comment-driven capability from documented Pages behaviour and correctly leaves its specific default, permissions and licensing open.

claims.claim: TCM supports these Copilot settings only in tenant-level Microsoft 365 Apps admin center policies.

claims.claim: applyOnce fails for this resource if the setting is configured in any group-level Apps admin center policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and `applyOnce` fail for that resource.
